title: SQL 分析查询模式 (Analytics Patterns)
description: SQL 工作流系列 (14/16)：EXISTS vs IN、JOIN 替代子查询、透视表、覆盖索引、前缀索引与慢查询分析

content.tips: 用 EXISTS 查有已付款订单的用户：users u，子查询 SELECT 1 FROM orders o，条件 o.user_id = u.id 且 o.status 为 paid
content.content: SELECT * FROM users u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id AND o.status = 'paid');

content.tips: 用 IN 子查询：查 users 中 id 落在 vip_list 的 user_id 集合内的行
content.content: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM vip_list);

content.tips: 用 JOIN 替代子查询：users u 连 orders o（ON u.id = o.user_id），筛 o.status 为 paid，取 DISTINCT u.*
content.content: SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = 'paid';

content.tips: orders 按 user_id 分组做透视：SUM+CASE 统计 status 为 paid 的 amount（别名 paid）和 refund 的 amount（别名 refund）
content.content: SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS paid, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refund' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS refund FROM orders GROUP BY user_id;

content.tips: orders 按 product_id 分组做月度透视：用 MONTH(created_at) 判 1 月（别名 jan）和 2 月（别名 feb）的 amount 合计
content.content: SELECT product_id, SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(created_at) = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS jan, SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(created_at) = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS feb FROM orders GROUP BY product_id;

content.tips: 不用 SELECT *：查 users 的 id, name, email，筛 status 为 active
content.content: SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE status = 'active';

content.tips: 给 orders(user_id, status, amount) 建覆盖索引，名为 idx_cover
content.content: CREATE INDEX idx_cover ON orders(user_id, status, amount);

content.tips: 给 users 的 name 建前 10 个字符的前缀索引，名为 idx_name
查 orders 中 user_id 为 100 的所有列，并强制走索引 idx_user_id
content.content: SELECT * FROM orders FORCE INDEX (idx_user_id) WHERE user_id = 100;

content.tips: 用 EXPLAIN 分析：users u 连 orders o（ON u.id = o.user_id）取 u.name，筛 o.status 为 paid
content.content: EXPLAIN SELECT u.name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.status = 'paid';
